subject: Weekly capacity: Deal risk & action matrix (PilotAI)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly capacity check — PilotAI: risk + action matrix

Team,

Quick pulse on PilotAI (PL-2027-311) ahead of Friday's exec review. Key facts: PilotAI is asking for a dedicated capacity commit with predictable burst allowance for a 6-month pilot starting Sep 1. Forecasted monthly token burn from their initial workload is ~12B tokens/month, but their burst profile (real-time inferencing for peak shopping events) requires headroom of ~300 concurrent streams for short windows.

I've attached a sizing worksheet and their burst profile. I ran a quick conservative mapping and we're looking at ~18 x A100-equivalent slots to guarantee their 99th percentile latency target with prefix caching enabled. That sits in a medium-risk band given our current reserved slot utilization for Q3.

Asking for a short action matrix today so we can present a reconciled ask at the Friday review:
1) Sales (Ben): confirm contract ask and acceptable fallback if we can't fully reserve the 18 slots.
2) Finance (Laura): cost impact and suggested billing cadence / credit structure for a 6-month pilot with burst escrow.
3) Infra (Aditya + Sergio): feasibility for a partial-reserve + burst-credits approach and infra changes needed (KV cache warmers, pre-warming windows).
4) Ops: simple runbook for degraded modes (what model variants we can fallback to, expected latency delta).

Please review the attached sizing-sheet and reply with short bullets. I'm aiming to consolidate an action matrix by 4pm PT so we have time to align with legal/ops before Friday.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
(jasmine.liu@redwood.ai)

Attachments: 20270721-sizing-sheet.xlsx (xlsx), pilotai_burst_profile.csv (csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly capacity check — PilotAI: risk + action matrix

Sending quick answers and a proposal for the sales fallback.

1) Contract ask: PilotAI prefers a firm reservation for 12 A100-equivalent slots with an option to burst up to the 18 slots in peak windows. Their legal asked for a two-tier pricing model: standard reserved rate + per-burst-minute charge capped per event.
2) Fallback: propose commit to 12 reserved slots (firm) + guaranteed burst pool of 4 slots (fast-path) and pay-per-use beyond that. If we can't guarantee burst beyond the 4 slots, we offer automatic geo-fallback to a lower-latency but higher-cost hosted pool with a maximum DRR (degradation rate) clause.

My recommendation: lead with the 12+4 firm offer in the deck, and show the explicit economics vs the 18-slot full reserve. I added a new tab in the sizing-sheet (see attachment) with a split-cost model.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Dedicated Sales

Thanks Jasmine & team — appreciate the clear write-up. A few clarifications from our side to help sizing:
- The 300 concurrent streams peak happens in two 1-hour windows per month (marketing-triggered). Outside of those windows our 99th percentile latency target is 120ms.
- We can tolerate a 20% latency increase during the peak windows if we get predictable pricing and no hard throttles.
- We're open to the 12 reserved + 4 fast-path burst approach, but we'd like a mechanism to purchase extra burst minutes in advance (pre-funded burst escrow) so our app won't be throttled mid-event.

Question: what would the expected latency be if we geo-fallback to the hosted pool? We need an estimate so our infra team (cc'ed) can decide whether to add cross-region routing in their client.

Also attaching an updated SOW request (minor edits). Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Alicia Torres
Head of Product, PilotAI
(alicia.torres@pilotai.ai)

Thanks everyone — consolidating next steps and owners below (for the Friday packet):

Action matrix (owner — due)
- Finalize commercial proposal: Ben — EOD Thu (will include 12 reserved + 4 fast-path + pre-funded burst escrow options).
- Cost delta analysis (12 vs 18 reserve): Laura — EOD Thu (attached summary will go into the deck).
- Infra feasibility and warmers: Aditya + Sergio — tech note by Thu 11:00am (call out KV cache warm-up time, pre-warm windows, and required infra changes).
- Degradation runbook (fallback models + expected latency delta): Sergio — Thu 2:00pm.
- Legal redline readiness (SOW language for burst escrow & geo-fallback): Jasmine — coordinate with legal, target Thu 5:00pm.

Notes: From a finance POV, a pre-funded burst escrow looks fine if PilotAI can agree to a minimum purchase (suggested $25k) and we amortize against event consumption; I'll include modeled burn rates in the cost delta. If they prefer a rolling credit instead of up-front escrow, that increases cashflow risk but is doable with a higher per-burst-minute rate.

I'll assemble the packet once individual owners upload their short deliverables to the Drive link.

Laura
